#portal .world-canvas{display:none}
#portal .world-vignette{z-index:1;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#070b0ef5 0%,#091115c9 37%,#10161873 61%,#070b0e38 83%),linear-gradient(180deg,#04060676,transparent 29%,#05070913 54%,#06090cf5 100%)}
#portal.grain:after{opacity:.18;mix-blend-mode:soft-light;z-index:2}
.portal-grid{position:relative;z-index:4;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.12fr) minmax(200px,.7fr);max-width:1650px;gap:4vw}
.portal-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(88px,8.3vw,164px);max-width:960px;letter-spacing:-.082em;line-height:.94;margin:30px 0 29px;text-shadow:0 6px 60px #0009}
.portal-title i{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;color:#edc58c;display:block;text-shadow:0 0 65px #dca56843}
.portal-desc{max-width:605px;line-height:1.9;font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(15px,1.15vw,18px);color:#e1ded5;text-shadow:0 2px 15px #000e}
.portal-kicker{color:#edc38f;text-shadow:0 1px 12px #000;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.32em}
.portal-right{min-height:475px;justify-content:flex-end;align-items:flex-end;position:relative;padding-right:2vw;padding-bottom:8vh}
.exhibition-mark{width:205px;height:205px;border:1px solid #fce5bd6e;border-radius:50%;position:relative;background:radial-gradient(circle,#c49b6a1c,transparent 65%);box-shadow:0 0 0 24px #ffffff07,0 0 0 51px #ffffff05;display:grid;place-items:center;backdrop-filter:blur(1px);animation:float-mark 10s ease-in-out infinite}
.orbit-ring{position:absolute;inset:-38px;border:1px dashed #ead7b148;border-radius:50%;animation:mark-spin 70s linear infinite}.orbit-2{inset:35px;border-color:#eed6a74b;animation-direction:reverse}.exhibition-index{font:italic 110px/.8 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.09em;color:#fbdbacb5;margin-top:-22px}
.exhibition-detail{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 40px);width:260px;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px}.exhibition-detail span{font:600 9px var(--mono);letter-spacing:.22em;color:#d3bea0}.exhibition-detail b{font:normal 25px var(--serif);letter-spacing:.11em}.exhibition-detail em{font:normal 11px var(--mono);color:#ddb781;letter-spacing:.18em}
.hero-vertical{position:absolute;right:-5vw;top:4vh;writing-mode:vertical-rl;letter-spacing:.3em;font-size:10px;color:#e5d6bb85}
.portal-foot{z-index:7;bottom:32px;left:clamp(28px,7.7vw,154px);right:clamp(28px,7.7vw,154px);border-color:#ffffff50}
@keyframes hero-breathe{from{transform:scale(1.05) translateY(0)}to{transform:scale(1.125) translateY(-13px)}}@keyframes float-mark{50%{transform:translateY(-14px)}}@keyframes mark-spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
#experience{padding-top:82px}.section-nav{top:82px;padding-left:clamp(25px,4.5vw,85px);padding-right:clamp(25px,4.5vw,85px);background:#0b0e10f2}.navtab{padding:22px 25px 19px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em}
.chapter-head{position:relative;display:block;min-height:750px;overflow:hidden;background:#071014}
.chapter-stage{height:clamp(680px,84vh,940px);min-height:680px;isolation:isolate;background:#162329}
